changes.stage: after nearest-literature review, before real-data decomposition
changes.change: Replace the initial degree-2/3/4 truncation direction with a complete-bivariate comparator and a graph-sufficiency theorem. Molecular degree alone did not isolate the number of involved genes.

Use fresh seeds with 16384 draws per batch for C169 and C168, 1024 for C132/C171/C156, each with 32 batches. Two original close inversions disappeared; full26 R2-to-R500 inversions changed from 121 to 119, and the subset requiring shared capacity from 78 to 76.

Use exchangeable-label Monte Carlo permutation tests as the primary detection analysis, retaining the Wald results as a diagnostic. The initial Wald test showed inflated rejection in some small-sample settings.

data_status: All CRC data had already been analyzed; none of this reanalysis is a newly held-out confirmation.
